crossRefs.note: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was…
He spoke three thousand proverbs; and his songs numbered one thousand five.
Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in…
I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in…
David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her. She bore a son, and he called his name…
and he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah, for Yahweh’s sake.
Solomon sat on David his father’s throne; and his kingdom was firmly established.
Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around…
Of all my sons (for Yahweh has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of Yahweh’s…
He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
